dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: But I must apologize. I don't have the power to grant wishes, or anything of that nature. Sorry to disappoint.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: The most I can do is turn water into wine, make all drinks taste delicious, do a little bit of healing... that sort of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Also... I do apologize that for now I can only talk to you from within the water.
